title: DEV FIXTURE: Lorem Corp supply-chain risk shift
question: How did Lorem Corp's Item 1A supply-chain risk language change between FY2024 and FY2025?
answer_md: Between FY2024 and FY2025, Lorem Corp added explicit single-source packaging concentration risk in Item 1A [1]. Management also noted a longer qualification cycle for secondary suppliers [2].

context.before: Our manufacturing operations depend on third-party assembly partners.
context.match: In fiscal 2025, we relied on a single packaging vendor for over 60% of high-margin units.
context.after: Any disruption at this facility could materially delay shipments.

context.before: We continue to evaluate alternate suppliers.
context.match: Qualifying a secondary vendor typically requires 9 to 12 months of testing.
context.after: Costs associated with dual-sourcing are reflected in cost of revenue.

context.before: Lorem Corp operates facilities across three regions.
context.match: General warehouse leases renew on a three-year schedule.
context.after: We believe our current facilities are adequate.

context.match: General warehouse leases renew on a three-year schedule.
context.after: We believe our current facilities are adequate.
